description: This file defines the Error package for exception handling in Perl, including classes Error, Error::Simple, and Error::subs, with methods for error creation, propagation, and handling, as well as error stack trace and signal handling.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: Base class for error objects with methods for error information, stack trace, and error association.

classes.name: Error::Simple
classes.description: Subclass of Error for simple string-based errors with additional file and line info.

classes.name: Error::subs
classes.description: Provides exception handling syntax with try, catch, finally, except, and otherwise clauses.

classes.name: Error::WarnDie
classes.description: Handles warning and die signal processing, generating call stacks and error messages.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Imports exception handling clauses and error handling behaviors.

methods.name: prior
methods.description: Returns the last error created or associated with a package.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Clears the last error for a package or globally.

methods.name: stacktrace
methods.description: Returns the stack trace of an error if debugging is enabled.

methods.name: associate
methods.description: Associates an error object with another object for propagation.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Creates a new error object, capturing caller info and optional stack trace.

methods.name: throw
methods.description: Throws the error object, causing it to be caught or terminate the program.

methods.name: with
methods.description: Creates and returns an error object for syntactic sugar.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Creates and returns an error object for recording errors without throwing.

methods.name: catch
methods.description: Defines a catch clause for handling specific error classes.

methods.name: object
methods.description: Returns the object associated with the error.

methods.name: file
methods.description: Returns the filename where the error was created.

methods.name: line
methods.description: Returns the line number where the error was created.

methods.name: stringify
methods.description: String representation of the error, typically the error message.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Returns an associated value with the error.
